name: sol-advisor
description: Haru fork of Sol Advisor with explicit Sol/Luna/Terra model-specific routing and workstream-level research routing with dedicated read-only Luna/Terra researchers.

interface.shortDescription: Sol plans; model-pinned implementers, researchers, and fresh review are used selectively.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6.1 Sol / High in the primary Codex session for architecture, requirements, verification, and acceptance. Fully specified bounded routine implementation is preferentially delegated to GPT-6 Luna / Max. Judgment-heavy, architecture-sensitive, context-heavy, high-risk, or wide-blast-radius implementation goes to GPT-5.6 Terra / High. Audit and full routes use a fresh read-only GPT-6.1 Sol / High reviewer. Research is routed independently at the workstream level: short or execution-state-coupled work stays inline, bounded evidence gathering can use GPT-6 Luna / Max, and judgment-heavy investigation can use GPT-5.6 Terra / High. Dedicated researchers are read-only, use fresh context, and do not delegate further. Context isolation/compression, coverage, fresh context, or latency can justify delegation when they exceed coordination cost; parallelism is not required.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare implementation/review and research axes in a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.

Keep architecture and acceptance in Sol; route self-contained read-only research workstreams to dedicated Luna/Terra researchers when isolation, compression, coverage, fresh context, or latency pays for coordination cost; do not route whole tasks merely because they are sequential.
